title: 飛輪儲能電機控制
summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討旋轉動能、雙向電機與飛輪損耗管理，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore rotational energy, bidirectional machines and flywheel loss management, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。飛輪破裂、真空與軸承失效有重大實體風險；僅做離線能量及控制建模，不提供轉子製造或超速測試程序。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. Rotor burst, vacuum and bearing failures are significant physical hazards; this is offline energy/control modeling, not rotor fabrication or overspeed testing.

stages.title: 能量與轉速
stages.description: 以三個具體技術單元完成能量與轉速；每單元先建立模型，再以對照和反證驗收。
stages.descriptionEn: Complete energy and speed through three technical units, each pairing a model with controlled verification.

steps.title: 轉換 rpm 與角速度：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Convert rpm and angular speed: build the model
steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解轉換 rpm 與角速度，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand convert rpm and angular speed through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 將 10,000 rpm 乘 2π/60 得 1,047.2 rad/s，檢查平方單位。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: Convert 10,000 rpm using 2π/60 to 1,047.2 rad/s and check squared units. First draw the system boundary and energy/signal direction. State units, definitions and controlled conditions, then predict the result. Use offline models or already available public records only.
steps.observation: 將 10,000 rpm 乘 2π/60 得 1,047.2 rad/s，檢查平方單位。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Convert 10,000 rpm using 2π/60 to 1,047.2 rad/s and check squared units. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：轉動慣量 J=10 kg·m²，轉速由 10,000 降至 5,000 rpm，ΔE=J(ω₁²−ω₂²)/2≈4.112 MJ=1.142 kWh。速度減半後仍有四分之一初始能量；高轉速同時提高轉子應力。 飛輪破裂、真空與軸承失效有重大實體風險；僅做離線能量及控制建模，不提供轉子製造或超速測試程序。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: with J=10 kg·m² and speed falling from 10,000 to 5,000 rpm, ΔE=J(ω₁²−ω₂²)/2≈4.112 MJ=1.142 kWh. Halving speed leaves one quarter of initial energy; high speed also increases rotor stress. Rotor burst, vacuum and bearing failures are significant physical hazards; this is offline energy/control modeling, not rotor fabrication or overspeed testing.

knowledge.text: 比較薄環 J=mr² 與實心圓盤 J=mr²/2，明示幾何理想化。

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：轉動慣量 J=10 kg·m²，轉速由 10,000 降至 5,000 rpm，ΔE=J(ω₁²−ω₂²)/2≈4.112 MJ=1.142 kWh。速度減半後仍有四分之一初始能量；高轉速同時提高轉子應力。 飛輪破裂、真空與軸承失效有重大實體風險；僅做離線能量及控制建模，不提供轉子製造或超速測試程序。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: with J=10 kg·m² and speed falling from 10,000 to 5,000 rpm, ΔE=J(ω₁²−ω₂²)/2≈4.112 MJ=1.142 kWh. Halving speed leaves one quarter of initial energy; high speed also increases rotor stress. Rotor burst, vacuum and bearing failures are significant physical hazards; this is offline energy/control modeling, not rotor fabrication or overspeed testing.

optionsEn: If a number is near its nominal value, units, boundaries and errors do not need checking.

steps.title: 分析慣量分布：反證與驗收
steps.titleEn: Analyze inertia distribution: challenge and acceptance
steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解分析慣量分布，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand analyze inertia distribution through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 先沿用模型，寫下會推翻「相同質量放在不同半徑有不同慣量與結構應力。」的觀察。比較薄環 J=mr² 與實心圓盤 J=mr²/2，明示幾何理想化。 加入一個對照條件，分開記錄原始數據、推論與不確定度；若前提失效則暫緩判定。
steps.instructionEn: Use the model and state an observation that would refute this claim: Equal mass at different radii produces different inertia and structural stress. Compare thin-ring J=mr² and solid-disc J=mr²/2, stating idealized geometry. Add a control condition and separate raw data, inference and uncertainty. Withhold acceptance if assumptions fail.
steps.observation: 比較薄環 J=mr² 與實心圓盤 J=mr²/2，明示幾何理想化。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Compare thin-ring J=mr² and solid-disc J=mr²/2, stating idealized geometry. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「分析慣量分布」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把旋轉動能、雙向電機與飛輪損耗管理的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If analyze inertia distribution disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of rotational energy, bidirectional machines and flywheel loss management behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「分析慣量分布」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for analyze inertia distribution, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.
